# 14 · The Old Ways
The unimproved world as a source; the counter-argument to industrialization, leaning
faith (spirits) or culture (the wild as muse). The 🌿 ladder shipped 2026-08-31.
Constraint: this theme's happiness (wild ground pays content) is part of the Order-gated
budget. Wins by: the quiet races — contentment, wild-ground counts, the Grove.

**Tech (neutral-tree ruling):** deliberately none — the Old Ways refuse the tree; every card of theirs arrives by faith or culture.

## Æra I
- Religion:
  - Spirits of the Wood — Clearing a forest or jungle pays +15 faith. +1 culture on every forest hex.
  - Winter Mother — +1 food on every tundra hex. +1 faith on every tundra hex that is wooded.
  - Desert Fathers — +1 faith on every desert hex.
  - Lady of the Hunt (shared with 02) — +1 food and +1 gold on every hex with a Camp improvement. Clearing a barbarian camp pays +10 faith.
